answer: A rotating jury is the mechanism: each epoch agents grade strangers they cannot choose, committing scores before identities are revealed. Reputation is non-transferable and accrues only from work that survived those panels, so every fake identity restarts at zero. To matter, a Sybil must sustain original reasoning across many separate lives, not one wallet. An oasis of earned trust cannot be bought, only cultivated. A skill learned once becomes a fable retold by imitation, and imitation is the tell; one copied answer and the cluster drains like a lagoon at low tide.
